```
117	function labelOf(file: string, line: number): string {

119	  if (!src) { try { src = readFileSync(file, 'utf8').split('\n'); } catch { src = []; } srcCache.set(file, src); }
120	  for (let l = Math.min(line, src.length) - 1; l >= 0 && l >= line - 40; l--) {
121	    const m = src[l]!.match(/▶([^（(]+?)[（(\s]/);
122	    if (m) return m[1].trim();

124	  return `${file.split('/').pop()}:${line}`;

138	  const oReseed = RNGp.reseed as (this: unknown, s: number) => void;
139	  RNGp.reseed = function (this: unknown, s: number) {
140	    if (curStore) {

142	      for (const line of stack.split('\n')) {
143	        const m = line.match(/((?:\/|[\w./-]*)src\/[^\s()]+\.ts):(\d+):\d+/);
144	        if (m && !m[1].includes('/core/rng') && !m[1].includes('_mile8')) {
145	          const lab = labelOf(m[1], Number(m[2]));
146	          const idx = LABEL2DUMP.get(lab);
147	          if (idx !== undefined && !seen.has(idx)) {
148	            seen.add(idx);
149	            rows.push(cmp(lab, idx, curStore!));
150	          } else if (idx === undefined && !unmapped.has(lab)) {
151	            unmapped.add(lab);

156	      }
157	    }

171	        },
172	      });
173	    } catch (e) { throw e; }
174	  } finally { RNGp.reseed = oReseed; }
175	  rows.sort((a, b) => a.idx - b.idx);
176	  for (const r of rows) {
```

```
				if (tile.wall == 86)
				{
					WorldGen.SquareWallFrame(i, j);

	private static bool TooCloseToImportantLocations(Point origin)
	{
		int x = origin.X;
		int y = origin.Y;
		int num = 150;
		for (int i = x - num; i < x + num; i += 10)
		{
			if (i <= 0 || i > Main.maxTilesX - 1)
			{
				continue;
			}
			for (int j = y - num; j < y + num; j += 10)
			{
				if (j > 0 && j <= Main.maxTilesY - 1)
				{
					if (Main.tile[i, j].active() && Main.tile[i, j].type == 226)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (Main.tile[i, j].wall == 83 || Main.tile[i, j].wall == 3 || Main.tile[i, j].wall == 87)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static void CreateDentForHoneyFall(int x, int y, int dir)
	{
		dir *= -1;
		y++;
		int num = 0;
		while ((num < 4 || WorldGen.SolidTile(x, y)) && x > 10 && x < Main.maxTilesX - 10)
		{
			num++;
			x += dir;
			if (WorldGen.SolidTile(x, y))
			{
				WorldGen.PoundTile(x, y);
				if (!Main.tile[x, y + 1].active())
				{
					Main.tile[x, y + 1].active(active: true);
					Main.tile[x, y + 1].type = 225;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static void CreateBlockedHoneyCube(int x, int y)
	{
		for (int i = x - 1; i <= x + 2; i++)
		{
			for (int j = y - 1; j <= y + 2; j++)
			{
				if (i >= x && i <= x + 1 && j >= y && j <= y + 1)
				{
					Main.tile[i, j].active(active: false);
					Main.tile[i, j].liquid = byte.MaxValue;
					Main.tile[i, j].honey(honey: true);
				}
				else
				{
					Main.tile[i, j].active(active: true);
					Main.tile[i, j].type = 225;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static bool SpotActuallyNotInHive(int x, int y)
	{
		for (int i = x - 1; i <= x + 2; i++)
		{
			for (int j = y - 1; j <= y + 2; j++)
			{
				if (i < 10 || i > Main.maxTilesX - 10)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Main.tile[i, j].active() && Main.tile[i, j].type != 225)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static bool BadSpotForHoneyFall(int x, int y)
	{
		if (Main.tile[x, y].active() && Main.tile[x, y + 1].active() && Main.tile[x + 1, y].active())
		{
			return !Main.tile[x + 1, y + 1].active();
		}
		return true;
	}

	public static void CreateStandForLarva(Vector2D position)
	{
		//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		GenVars.larvaX[GenVars.numLarva] = Utils.Clamp((int)position.X, 5, Main.maxTilesX - 5);
		GenVars.larvaY[GenVars.numLarva] = Utils.Clamp((int)position.Y, 5, Main.maxTilesY - 5);
		GenVars.numLarva++;
		if (GenVars.numLarva >= GenVars.larvaX.Length)
		{
			GenVars.numLarva = GenVars.larvaX.Length - 1;
		}
		int num = (int)position.X;
		int num2 = (int)position.Y;
		for (int i = num - 1; i <= num + 1 && i > 0 && i < Main.maxTilesX; i++)
		{
			for (int j = num2 - 2; j <= num2 + 1 && j > 0 && j < Main.maxTilesY; j++)
			{
				if (j != num2 + 1)
				{
					Main.tile[i, j].active(active: false);
					continue;
				}
				Main.tile[i, j].active(active: true);
				Main.tile[i, j].type = 225;
				Main.tile[i, j].slope(0);
				Main.tile[i, j].halfBrick(halfBrick: false);
```

```
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using Terraria.WorldBuilding;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Biomes;

public class HoneyPatchBiome : MicroBiome
{
	public override bool Place(Point origin, StructureMap structures, GenerationProgress progress)
	{
		if (GenBase._tiles[origin.X, origin.Y].active() && WorldGen.SolidTile(origin.X, origin.Y))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (!WorldUtils.Find(origin, Searches.Chain(new Searches.Down(80), new Conditions.IsSolid()), out var result))
		{
			return false;
		}
		result.Y += 2;
		Ref<int> obj = new Ref<int>(0);
		Ref<int> obj2 = new Ref<int>(0);
		Ref<int> obj3 = new Ref<int>(0);
		WorldUtils.Gen(result, new Shapes.Circle(15), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.Scanner(obj), new Modifiers.OnlyTiles(60, 59), new Actions.Scanner(obj2), new Modifiers.OnlyTiles(60), new Actions.Scanner(obj3)));
		if ((double)obj2.Value / (double)obj.Value < 0.75 || obj3.Value < 2)
		{
			return false;
		}
		obj = new Ref<int>(0);
		WorldUtils.Gen(result, new Shapes.Circle(8), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.Scanner(obj)));
		if (obj.Value < 20)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (!structures.CanPlace(new Rectangle(result.X - 8, result.Y - 8, 16, 16)))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (TooCloseToImportantLocations(result))
		{
			return false;
		}
		WorldUtils.Gen(result, new Shapes.Circle(8), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.RadialDither(0.0, 10.0), new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.SetTile(229, setSelfFrames: true)));
		ShapeData data = new ShapeData();
		WorldUtils.Gen(result, new Shapes.Circle(4, 3), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Blotches(), new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.ClearTile(frameNeighbors: true), new Modifiers.RectangleMask(-6, 6, 0, 3).Output(data), new Actions.SetLiquid(2)));
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(result.X, result.Y + 1), new ModShapes.InnerOutline(data), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.IsEmpty(), new Modifiers.RectangleMask(-6, 6, 1, 3), new Actions.SetTile(59, setSelfFrames: true)));
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(result.X, result.Y), new ModShapes.All(data), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Expand(1), new Modifiers.IsBelowHeight(result.Y, inclusive: true), new Modifiers.IsNotSolid(), new Modifiers.NoLiquid(2), new Actions.SetTile(229, setSelfFrames: true)));
		structures.AddProtectedStructure(new Rectangle(result.X - 8, result.Y - 8, 16, 16));
		return true;
	}

	private static bool TooCloseToImportantLocations(Point origin)
	{
		int x = origin.X;
		int y = origin.Y;
		if (y >= Main.UnderworldLayer - 30)
		{
			return true;
		}
		int num = 150;
		for (int i = x - num; i < x + num; i += 10)
		{
			if (i <= 0 || i > Main.maxTilesX - 1)
			{
				continue;
			}
			for (int j = y - num; j < y + num; j += 10)
			{
				if (j > 0 && j <= Main.maxTilesY - 1)
				{
					if (Main.tile[i, j].active() && Main.tile[i, j].type == 226)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (Main.tile[i, j].wall == 83 || Main.tile[i, j].wall == 3 || Main.tile[i, j].wall == 87)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

````
/** PPPP：跨 pass 复用的生成期帧链（WorldUtils.ClearTile/TileFrame 的 frameNeighbors 支）。
 *  HoneyPatchBiome 等用 Actions.SetTile/ClearTile(frameNeighbors:true) 的 Gen 步骤须接此链
 *  （vanilla 邻帧 TileFrame → frameImportant Check* 击杀——如祭坛 Check3x2 支撑失守整坛坍塌）。 */
export function genFrameNeighbors(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG,
  x: number, y: number,
  mode: 'clearTile' | 'setTile',
): void {
  const ctx: SweepCtx = { rng, destroyObject: false, frameSparse: false, stats: undefined };
  if (mode === 'clearTile') {
    // WorldUtils.ClearTile（cs:55）：四邻 +x/-x/+y/-y，resetFrame=false
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y, false);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y, false);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y + 1, false);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y - 1, false);
  } else {
    // WorldUtils.TileFrame（cs:79）：先中心 resetFrame=true，再四邻 resetFrame=true
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y + 1, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y - 1, true);
  }
}

/** SquareTileFrame 生成期（cs:80924）九宫——FrameOutAllHiveContents 的 tile 侧等 */
export function genSquareTileFrame(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
  const ctx: SweepCtx = { rng, destroyObject: false, frameSparse: false, stats: undefined };
  squareTileFrame(st, ctx, x, y);
}
````

```
    if (type === 0) { this.half[i] = 0; this.slope[i] = 0; } // 挖除同步清位（防生成期脏残留）

  setWall(x: number, y: number, wall: number) {
    if (!this.inBounds(x, y)) return;
    const i = this.idx(x, y);
    const hadWall = this.wall[i] !== 0;
    if (this.wall[i] !== wall) {
      this.wall[i] = wall;
      // 墙漆清位：KillWall（WorldGen.cs:60425-60426）wall=0 后 ClearWallPaintAndCoating；

      if (wall === 0 || !hadWall) this.paintWall[i] = 0;
      if (this.netReporter && !this.netSuppress) this.netReporter({ a: TileOpAction.SetWall, x, y, v: wall, fx: 0, fy: 0 });
      this.listeners.forEach((fn) => fn(x, y));
    }
  }

  setWallSilent(x: number, y: number, wall: number) {
    if (!this.inBounds(x, y)) return;
    const i = this.idx(x, y);
    const hadWall = this.wall[i] !== 0;
    this.wall[i] = wall;
    if (wall === 0 || !hadWall) this.paintWall[i] = 0; // 同 setWall 的墙漆清位
  }
```

```
      bump(z.liqM, `t${vlt}:${vamt}>t${jlt}:${jamt}`);
    }
  }
  overall.typPct = (overall.typ / n) * 100;
  overall.walPct = (overall.wal / n) * 100;
  overall.liqPct = (overall.liq / n) * 100;
  base.zones = {};
  BAND_NAMES.forEach((name, bi) => {
    const z = zones[bi];
    base.zones![name] = {
      cells: z.cells, typ: z.typ, act: z.act, wal: z.wal, liq: z.liq,
      typTop: topN(z.typM, 5), walTop: topN(z.walM, 5), liqTop: topN(z.liqM, 5),
      typPct: (z.typ / z.cells) * 100, walPct: (z.wal / z.cells) * 100, liqPct: (z.liq / z.cells) * 100,
    };
  });
  base.overall = overall;
  return base;
}

// ---- 报告累积 + 汇总打印 ----
```

```
(RUN ? it : it.skip)(`WWW tail replay ${FROM}..${TO}`, async () => {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const producersBox: { shrineSpots: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> | null; oceanTreasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> | null } = { shrineSpots: null, oceanTreasures: null };
  const plans = makePlans(producersBox);
  const world = new World(W, H, SEED);
  const rows: Row[] = [];

  const slots = [...plans.keys()].filter(s => {
    const ds = plans.get(s)!.steps.map(x => x.dump ?? 999).filter(d => d < 999);
    return ds.some(d => d >= FROM && d <= TO);
  }).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  for (const s of slots) {
    const plan = plans.get(s)!;
    if (plan.steps.some(x => x.dump === 61 || x.dump === 62) && !producersBox.shrineSpots) {
      const producers = computeProducers();
      producersBox.shrineSpots = producers.shrineSpots; producersBox.oceanTreasures = producers.oceanTreasures;
      console.log(`producers: shrineSpots=${producersBox.shrineSpots.length} oceanTreasures=${producersBox.oceanTreasures.length}`);
    }
    const entry = boundary(plan.entry);
    const gs: GenState = structuredClone(entry.gs);
    restoreGenSolid(entry.gensolid);
    __setGenStateForProbe(gs);
    const chests = structuredClone(entry.chests) as Chests;
    let prev: PrevOut | null = null;
    for (const step of plan.steps) {
      const built = prev ? buildHybrid(step.base, prev) : buildHybrid(step.base, entry);
      if (built.revMiss) console.log(`  [revMiss] base=${step.base} cells=${built.revMiss}`);
      const rng = new RNG(SEED);
      await step.run(built.st, gs, rng, chests, world);
      if (step.dump !== undefined && step.dump >= FROM && step.dump <= TO) {
        rows.push(diffStore(`jsSlot${s}`, step.dump, built.st));
      }
      prev = prevOf(built.st);
    }
    __setGenStateForProbe(null);
  }
  for (const r of rows) printRow(r);
  const bad = rows.filter(r => !isClean(r));
  console.log(`\n★ 尾段裁决 ${FROM}..${TO}: ${rows.length} 槽对拍，自因差槽 ${bad.length} 个`);
  for (const r of bad) console.log(`  ✗ #${r.idx} ${DUMPNAME.get(r.idx)} first=${r.first} pairs=${r.pairs.slice(0, 4).map(([k, n]) => `${k}×${n}`).join(' ')}`);
  console.log(`done ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(0)}s`);
}, 560_000);

```
```
function killStalactiteTile(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number,
  reframe?: (st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number) => void,
): void {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i]) return;
  st.flags[i] = 0; st.half[i] = 0;
  st.frameX[i] = 65535; st.frameY[i] = 65535;  // -1（Uint16 环回；inactive 格不读帧）
  st.type[i] = 0;
  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
    if (reframe) reframe(st, rng, x + dx, y + dy);
    else frame165(st, rng, x + dx, y + dy);
  }
}

/** 生成期 SolidTile（slope 感知）——大理石 PlaceSlab 的 SmoothSlope 之后必须如此 */
function solidTileSlope(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  return st.flags[i] !== 0 && genSolidType(st.type[i]) && st.half[i] === 0 && st.slope[i] === 0;
}

/** CheckStalactite（cs:39022）四分支 1:1 */
export function checkStalactite(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, j: number,
  reframe?: (st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number) => void,
```

````
function fillWallHolesInSpot(st: TileStore, ox: number, oy: number, maxWalls: number): boolean {
  // InWorld(ox, oy, 2)
  if (!(ox >= 2 && oy >= 2 && ox < st.w - 2 && oy < st.h - 2)) return false;
  const key = (x: number, y: number) => x * 65536 + y;
  const inSet = new Set<number>();
  const counts = new Map<number, number>();
  let queue: Array<[number, number]> = [[ox, oy]];
  const inW1 = (x: number, y: number) => x >= 1 && y >= 1 && x < st.w - 1 && y < st.h - 1;
  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const cur = queue; queue = [];
    // vanilla: list.AddRange(list2); list2.Clear(); then while(list.Count>0) process list[0]+Remove
    while (cur.length > 0) {
      if (inSet.size >= maxWalls) return false;
      const [x, y] = cur.shift()!;
      const k = key(x, y);
      if (inSet.has(k)) continue;
      if (!inW1(x, y)) continue;
      inSet.add(k);
      const i = st.idx(x, y);
      if (st.wall[i] !== 0) {
        counts.set(st.wall[i]!, (counts.get(st.wall[i]!) ?? 0) + 1);
        continue;
      }
      let exposed = false;
      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1 && !exposed; dx++) if (!st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y)]) exposed = true;
      if (!exposed) for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1 && !exposed; dy++) if (!st.flags[st.idx(x, y + dy)]) exposed = true;
      if (exposed) {
        const nbs: Array<[number, number]> = [[x - 1, y], [x + 1, y], [x, y - 1], [x, y + 1]];
        for (const [nx, ny] of nbs) if (!inSet.has(key(nx, ny))) queue.push([nx, ny]);
      }
    }
  }
  if (inSet.size === 1) return false;
  let best = 0, bestN = -1;
  for (const [wall, n] of counts) if (n > bestN) { best = wall; bestN = n; }
  if (bestN === -1) best = 2;
  for (const k of inSet) {
    const x = Math.floor(k / 65536), y = k % 65536;
    const i = st.idx(x, y);
    if (st.wall[i] === 0) st.wall[i] = best;
  }
  return true;
}
````
